description: Executes any command N times in a loop, each iteration processes independently through termy. Use commas (,) to separate subcommands inside the loop.

arguments.command: n='<||n||>' && cmd='<||string||>' && cmd="${cmd//,/;}" && for i in $(seq 1 "$n"); do echo "\n━━━ [$i/$n] executing: $cmd ━━━" && termy "$cmd" || break; done
arguments.explanation: Loops N times, invoking termy with the specified command each iteration. Converts commas to semicolons for proper message splitting within each iteration.
arguments.goal: Execute command N times with independent processing

description: Pauses execution for specified milliseconds. Use 'random' keyword to generate random delay up to max.

arguments.command: d='<||d||>' && if [[ "$d" == *"random"* ]]; then max_ms=$(echo "$d" | sed 's/[^0-9]//g') && random_ms=$((RANDOM * RANDOM % (max_ms + 1))) && sleep "$(echo "scale=3; $random_ms / 1000" | bc)"; else sleep "$(echo "scale=3; $d / 1000" | bc)"; fi
arguments.explanation: Pauses for specified milliseconds. If 'random' is in the string, generates random delay up to the specified maximum.
